name: effect-foil-sheen-tilt
title: Metallic Foil Tilt
description: Thẻ nhũ nghiêng qua lại ±24°, một dải sáng nghiêng gồm ba vệt chạy ngược chiều nghiêng như ánh kim loại, mặt thẻ tối đi khi nghiêng nhiều.

moworks.notes: Card 144x92 (78 % accent), perspective 380: rotateY 0 → −24° (0.3-1.2 s), hold, → +24° (1.6-2.7 s), hold, → 0 (3.1-3.9 s), power2.inOut. A skewed light band (soft strip 28 % wide at 28 %, bright 4.5 % at 75 %, thin 2.5 % at 55 %, skew 16 % of the width) sits at x = 58 % − (tilt / 24°) × 34 %, so it moves opposite the tilt; a dark overlay of 0.7 × |tilt in rad| (max ≈ 29 %). Chip outline, 'FOIL' type, soft shadow below. Params: tilt (±24°) · perspective (380) · band (28 % / 4.5 % / 2.5 %) · moves (0.9-1.1 s, power2.inOut). Tilts to −24°, holds, to +24°, holds, back to 0 (power2.inOut); the band sits at 58 % − (tilt / 24°) × 34 %, so it moves against the tilt; the face darkens 0.7 × |tilt in radians|.
